statement.en: Where groups with less of an amount leave no offspring, nothing is selected against it among groups; on the base, a group whose own condition ran into joint excess leaves none. One condition shared by every group ends every group, so it supplies no selection among them.
statement.zh: 某量较少的组不留后代时，组间无逆向于它的选择；在流上，自身条件遭遇共同过度的组不留后代。每个组共享的一个条件终止每个组，故不提供组间选择。

laws.en: Where every group with less of an amount than another leaves no offspring, nothing is discordant among the groups; so the whole selects for the amount exactly where k times the within-group discordance is below k times the within-group concordance with the concordance among groups.
laws.zh: 每个某量少于另一组的组都不留后代时，组间无不一致；故整体恰在 k 倍组内不一致度低于 k 倍组内一致度加组间一致度时选择该量。

laws.en: With groups uniform in the amount as well, the whole never selects against it, and selects for it wherever a group with more of it leaves offspring beside one with less.
laws.zh: 各组在该量上也均匀时，整体从不逆向于它；凡有某量较多且留下后代的组与较少的组并存，整体就选择它。

laws.en: Where only active formations give, a formation not active at a step leaves no descendant across it; a member depending, at a need of at least m, on a condition whose gated renewal ran into joint excess leaves none from then on.
laws.zh: 只有活跃的形成给予时，在某一步不活跃的形成不跨该步留下后代；以至少 m 的需要依存于其门控更新遭遇共同过度之条件的成员，此后不留后代。

laws.en: Over generations of descent a member not active has offspring number nothing, a group of such members leaves no offspring, and where the groups with less of the amount are such groups, those groups leave nothing.
laws.zh: 在世系世代中，不活跃的成员后代数为零，由这样的成员组成的组不留后代；某量较少的组皆为这样的组时，它们不留任何后代。

laws.en: With exact transmission and groups uniform in the amount, where the groups with less of it are not active and a group with more of it leaves offspring beside one with less, the mean amount rises across the step. With groups not uniform, the mean rises exactly where k times the within-group discordance is below k times the within-group concordance with the concordance among groups.
laws.zh: 传递精确且各组在该量上均匀时，若某量较少的组不活跃，且有某量较多、留下后代的组与较少的组并存，则平均量跨该步上升。各组不均匀时，均值恰在 k 倍组内不一致度低于 k 倍组内一致度加组间一致度时上升。

laws.en: Where every member of a generation is not active, as where every group depends on one condition that ran into joint excess, the next generation is empty: one shared condition leaves no group to select among.
laws.zh: 一代的每个成员都不活跃时，例如每个组都依存于同一个遭遇共同过度的条件，下一代为空：一个共同条件不留下可供组间选择的组。

laws.en: Witnesses: the keeping group and a group whose condition ended. With the member holding back leaving one offspring and its groupmate two, selection among groups outweighs selection within and the whole selects for holding back; with the groupmate leaving five, selection within outweighs and the whole goes against it.
laws.zh: 见证：保持之组与条件已终止之组。保留者留下一个后代、同组者两个时，组间选择胜过组内选择，整体选择保留；同组者留下五个时，组内选择胜出，整体逆向于保留。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Groups of equal size for the division. On the base: only active formations give, activity needs support, balance at the condition, the gate (whatever gives to it depends on it at a need of at least m), n steps of joint excess from a level below n + m, members depending on the condition at such a need. Over generations: descent, the generation listed as the groups, groups uniform in the amount and exact transmission where named.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。划分需各组大小相等。流上：只有活跃的形成给予、活动需要支持、该条件处的平衡、门控（给予它的都以至少 m 的需要依存于它）、自低于 n + m 的水平起 n 步共同过度、成员以这样的需要依存于该条件。世代：世系、该代列为这些组、所列处各组在该量上均匀且传递精确。

does_not_show.en: Which group's condition runs into joint excess, or why: it is a hypothesis wherever it enters, as is that members depend on their own group's condition.
does_not_show.zh: 哪个组的条件遭遇共同过度，或为什么：凡出现处都是假设；成员依存于本组条件亦然。

does_not_show.en: Mixed groups and inexact transmission: there selection within the surviving groups enters and can outweigh (Outweighs); mixing between groups is not stated (groups whose conditions are coupled: record groups-whose-conditions-are-coupled).
does_not_show.zh: 混合的组与不精确的传递：此时幸存组内的选择进入并可能胜出（Outweighs）；组间混合未陈述（条件相互耦合的组：记录 groups-whose-conditions-are-coupled）。

does_not_show.en: How groups form, or that keeping a condition is better: ending is read in the counts; ranking goes through the comparison C.
does_not_show.zh: 组如何形成，或维持条件更好：终止在计数中读出；排序经由比较 C。

detail.en: Ending among groups does not decide the whole: with the other group ended, a groupmate leaving five against one holding back leaving one makes the whole select against holding back (Outweighs.outweighs).
detail.zh: 组间的终止不决定整体：另一组已终止时，同组者留下五个、保留者留下一个，使整体逆向于保留（Outweighs.outweighs）。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261020T115958.613759Z): the 25 declarations of Becoming.GroupEnding, 20 of them theorems, have empty axiom reports; the checker verifies core purity. Built and reviewed in one session, with no separate reviewer; author review in study section 249; not independently reviewed by a person.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261020T115958.613759Z）：Becoming.GroupEnding 的 25 项声明（20 项定理）公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。在一个会话中构建并审查，没有另设审查者；作者审查见研究第 249 节；未经人的独立审查。

next_delta.en: Mixing between groups; how groups form; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 组间混合；组如何形成；独立审查。

correspondence.en: Group selection by differential extinction (Wright 1945; Levins 1970 on metapopulation extinction; Wilson and Sober 1994): groups whose members overuse a resource of their own go extinct, while within each group selection may favour overuse. Here extinction is the gated ending of the group's own condition, and the shared-condition corollary is the tragedy of the commons read with descent (Hardin 1968). Readings (the AI's): a condition of one's own is what lets ending select among groups; a commons shared by all ends all.
correspondence.zh: 经由差异性灭绝的组选择（Wright 1945；Levins 1970 论集合种群灭绝；Wilson 与 Sober 1994）：成员过度使用自身资源的组灭绝，而各组内的选择可能偏向过度使用。此处灭绝即组自身条件的门控终止；共同条件的推论即连同世系读出的公地悲剧（Hardin 1968）。读法（AI 的）：自身的条件使终止能在组间选择；所有人共享的公地终止所有人。

detail.en: Reuses Becoming.SelectionLevels' division of the selection term (levels, rises_iff, levels_of_uniform) and the family listed by groups (whole).
detail.zh: 复用 Becoming.SelectionLevels 对选择项的划分（levels、rises_iff、levels_of_uniform）与逐组列出的族（whole）。

output.en: The selection term divided into within-group and among-group parts.
output.zh: 分为组内与组间两部分的选择项。

input.en: The among-group part fixed by ending.
input.zh: 由终止所定的组间部分。

detail.en: Reuses Becoming.Continuation's Flow.joint_excess_ends: joint excess ends gated renewal and every formation depending on the condition at such a need.
detail.zh: 复用 Becoming.Continuation 的 Flow.joint_excess_ends：共同过度终止门控更新，以及以这样的需要依存于该条件的每个形成。

output.en: Members depending on a condition that ran into joint excess are not active from then on.
output.zh: 依存于遭遇共同过度之条件的成员此后不活跃。

input.en: Such members leave no descendants, and their group no offspring.
input.zh: 这样的成员不留后代，其组不留后代。

conditions.en: Balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, the gate.
conditions.zh: 平衡、只有活跃的形成给予、活动需要支持、门控。

detail.en: Its among-group part fixed by ending on the base.
detail.zh: 其组间部分由流上的终止所定。

detail.en: Lineages ending within closed families, read here for groups on conditions of their own.
detail.zh: 在封闭族内终止的世系，此处对依存于自身条件的组读出。

detail.en: Groups whose conditions are coupled end together; excess_childless is now the family of one.
detail.zh: 条件相互耦合的组一同终结；excess_childless 现为单元族的情形。

detail.en: Ending for groups of any sizes, and a witness of ending using up the differences among groups it acts on.
detail.zh: 任意大小之组的终止，以及终止耗尽其所作用的组间差异的见证。

detail.en: A rise by ending among groups, undone by a sampled generation with a bounded weight (Drift.Flow.ended_falls_back).
detail.zh: 组间终止带来的上升，被抽样的一代以有界的权重撤销（Drift.Flow.ended_falls_back）。

history.en: 20 October 2026: added (EV5), selection among groups fixed by ending on the base; study section 249.
history.zh: 2026年10月20日：新增（EV5），由流上的终止所定的组间选择；研究第 249 节。

history.en: 20 October 2026, EV5b: the base law Flow.rises_iff_inactive added (mixed groups, through SelectionLevels.rises_exact_iff_levels), so the evolution row's central laws reach the base; receipt 20261020T115958.613759Z, study section 259. The claim is unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月20日，EV5b：新增流上之律 Flow.rises_iff_inactive（混合的组，经由 SelectionLevels.rises_exact_iff_levels），演化一行的中心之律因而达到流上；回执 20261020T115958.613759Z，研究第 259 节。论断不变。

history.en: 20 October 2026, EV6: groups whose conditions are coupled are stated in Becoming.GroupEnding (Flow.family_childless, Flow.coupled_end_together, Flow.ended_of_family; record groups-whose-conditions-are-coupled, study section 265); Flow.excess_childless is now derived from Flow.family_childless, its statement unchanged. The claim is unchanged; its open item on coupled groups is answered there.
history.zh: 2026年10月20日，EV6：条件相互耦合的组陈述于 Becoming.GroupEnding（Flow.family_childless、Flow.coupled_end_together、Flow.ended_of_family；记录 groups-whose-conditions-are-coupled，研究第 265 节）；Flow.excess_childless 现由 Flow.family_childless 推出，陈述不变。论断不变；其关于耦合之组的开放项在那里回答。

history.en: 20 October 2026, EV7: Becoming.GroupEnding gains ending for groups of any sizes (EndedBy, means_not_against, Flow.rises_iff_inactive_sized) and the two-generation witness Exhausted (record selection-within-and-among-groups-of-any-sizes, study section 273); this record's laws and their statements are unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月20日，EV7：Becoming.GroupEnding 增加任意大小之组的终止（EndedBy、means_not_against、Flow.rises_iff_inactive_sized）与跨两代的见证 Exhausted（记录 selection-within-and-among-groups-of-any-sizes，研究第 273 节）；本记录的定律及其陈述不变。

history.en: 20 October 2026, EV8: Becoming.Drift states that a rise by ending among groups (raises_of_inactive) is undone by a sampled generation with a weight between q^n and a share falling as 1/n (record drift-offspring-sampled, study section 276); this record's laws and their statements are unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月20日，EV8：Becoming.Drift 陈述组间终止带来的上升（raises_of_inactive）被抽样的一代撤销，其权重介于 q^n 与随 1/n 下降的份额之间（记录 drift-offspring-sampled，研究第 276 节）；本记录的定律及其陈述不变。
